info.title: API.SH: GameStop
info.description: The GameStop API from API.SH: public GameStop data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One page (20 products) of a GameStop category, such as `video-games/nintendo-switch-2`, `consoles-hardware`, `toys-games/trading-cards` or `video-games/pre-owned`, with the same product fields as search. `facets` lists the category's refinements (platform, condition, franchise, genre, rating, price, new releases …), each value with its count and a `url`; pass that `url` back as `category` to refine (refinements stack). `sort` and `price_min`/`price_max` apply on top. `total` is the category's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gamestop-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path (e.g. `video-games/nintendo-switch-2`), a facet `url` from a previous response, or a gamestop.com category link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 products a page). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Nintendo Switch 2
Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered - Nintendo Switch 2

get.description:
One GameStop product by id or link: name, brand, publisher, platform, category, description, price (with `price_min`/`price_max` across conditions, `pro_price`, discounts and promotions), availability and delivery messages, pre-order and release date, in-store pickup, same-day delivery and ship-to-home flags, ESRB rating, genre, rating and review count, every variant (`variants`: New / Pre-Owned / Digital or colours and sizes, each with its id and availability), the condition selector with each option's price, the full spec sheet (`specs`: UPC, players, perspective, franchise, developer …), images and videos. A variant id answers that variant; the master id answers the product with all its variants. `raw` has the site's record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gamestop-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product or variant id (`master_id` or `id` in search results), or a gamestop.com product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a GameStop product: the rating summary (average, count, recommended count, star distribution) and each review with rating, title, text, date, nickname, recommendation, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and incentivized badges, photos and GameStop's responses. Sort and filter by star rating or photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gamestop-reviews

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1 to 5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

get.description:
Products matching words on GameStop (gamestop.com, US): 20 a page with every filter and sort of the search page. Each product: `id` (variant), `master_id`, `name`, `url`, `price`, `list_price` (when on sale), `pro_price` (member price), `available`, `preorder`, `in_store_pickup`, `same_day_delivery`, `digital`, `release_date`, `badge`, `rating`, `review_count`, `image`. `facets` lists every filter group with its `param` (e.g. `filter_platform`, `filter_condition`, `filter_brand`, `filter_franchise`, `filter_esrbRating`, `filter_genre`) and its values with counts; pass a value back as that param (several values separated by `|`). `total` is the site's result count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gamestop-search

parameters.name: filter_platform
parameters.description: Platform values from `facets` (the `filter_platform` group), separated by `|`, e.g. `Nintendo Switch|Nintendo Switch 2`. Every other facet works the same way with its own `param` (filter_condition, filter_brand, filter_genre, filter_franchise, filter_esrbRating, filter_publisher, filter_group_id, filter_consolidatedRating …).

parameters.name: in_store_pickup
parameters.description: `true`: only items available for in-store pickup.

parameters.name: ship_to_home
parameters.description: `true`: only items that ship to home.

parameters.name: same_day_delivery
parameters.description: `true`: only items eligible for same-day delivery.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 products a page). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: GameStop stores near a ZIP code
get.description:
GameStop stores near a US ZIP code, nearest first: store id, name, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, open now, today's closing time, opening hours per day (also as 24-hour open/close times), store status and directions link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gamestop-stores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
